title: 奥瑞利安·群星长河
description: 星龙盘成开阔长弧，金色角冠与蓝紫星云躯体在宇宙光带前显出庄重轮廓，完全不化为人形。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Aurelion Sol is an immense celestial dragon with a long serpentine blue-violet body, a proud dragon face, sweeping golden horns and head ornaments, a flowing cosmic mane, and small forelimbs. Preserve his nonhuman sinuous anatomy and long stellar tail, without human legs or clothing. His eyes are serene and authoritative, and the embedded stars remain decorative rather than projectiles or destructive effects.
art_direction.scene: Compose his entire body as an immense open arc across a sparse celestial horizon, head lifted in a still surveying pose and foreclaws relaxed. A broad band of directional starlight separates luminous gold edges from deep violet crayon planes. Keep the cosmos simple, with only a few distant spheres and generous dark space, avoiding any explosion or threatening approach.
art_direction.palette: deep periwinkle, indigo, antique gold, cold blue light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
